name: 遺伝性パントテン酸キナーゼ関連神経変性

summary.text: A rare neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive dystonia, dysarthria, retinal degeneration and abnormal iron accumulation in the globus pallidus and substantia nigra with a characteristic ''eye-of-the-tiger'' sign on T2-weighted MRI. Forms include classic disease with early onset and rapid progression and atypical disease with later onset and slower progression.
